Retrieve reporting data for ad groups. **groupBy (APPS):** deviceClass, ageRange, gender, countryCode, adminArea, locality, storefront, countryOrRegion **HOURLY granularity** requires the date range to start within the last 7 days. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for ads. **groupBy (APPS):** deviceClass, countryOrRegion (ageRange, gender, countryCode, adminArea, locality, deviceClass excluded for AD) **HOURLY granularity** is not supported for the AD entity. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for campaigns. **groupBy (APPS):** deviceClass, ageRange, gender, countryCode, adminArea, locality, storefront, countryOrRegion **HOURLY granularity** requires the date range to start within the last 7 days. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for keywords. **groupBy (APPS):** deviceClass, countryOrRegion (ageRange, gender, countryCode, adminArea, locality excluded for KEYWORD) **Only ORTZ timezone** is supported for the KEYWORD entity when using SEARCHTERM reporting. Applies to both APPS and BRANDS. **HOURLY granularity** requires the date range to start within the last 7 days. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for search terms. **groupBy (APPS):** deviceClass, countryOrRegion (ageRange, gender, countryCode, adminArea, locality excluded for SEARCHTERM) **EMPTY_METRICS** is not supported for SEARCHTERM in either APPS or BRANDS. **Only ORTZ timezone** is supported for the SEARCHTERM entity. UTC is excluded for both APPS and BRANDS. **HOURLY granularity** is not supported for the SEARCHTERM entity. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for ad groups. **groupBy (BRANDS):** deviceClass, locationId, supplyPlacement **EMPTY_METRICS** is not supported for BRANDS. **HOURLY granularity** requires the date range to start within the last 7 days. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for ads. **groupBy (BRANDS):** deviceClass, locationId, supplyPlacement **EMPTY_METRICS** is not supported for BRANDS. **HOURLY granularity** is not supported for the AD entity. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for campaigns. **groupBy (BRANDS):** deviceClass, locationId, supplyPlacement **EMPTY_METRICS** is not supported for BRANDS. **HOURLY granularity** requires the date range to start within the last 7 days. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for keywords. **groupBy (BRANDS):** deviceClass, locationId (supplyPlacement excluded for KEYWORD) **EMPTY_METRICS** is not supported for BRANDS. **Only ORTZ timezone** is supported for the KEYWORD entity when using SEARCHTERM reporting. Applies to both APPS and BRANDS. **HOURLY granularity** requires the date range to start within the last 7 days. **WEEKLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 14 days in the past. **MONTHLY granularity** requires the end date to be at least 90 days in the past.

Retrieve reporting data for search terms. **groupBy (BRANDS):** deviceClass, locationId (supplyPlacement excluded for SEARCHTERM) **EMPTY_METRICS** is not supported for SEARCHTERM in either APPS or BRANDS. **Only ORTZ timezone** is supported for the SEARCHTERM entity. get.summary: Searches for a list of apps

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text app search criteria. Matched against app name and developer name. Must contain at least one alphanumeric character. Minimum length of 3 characters (2 for CJK languages).

parameters.name: returnOwnedApps
parameters.description: When `true`, returns apps owned by the caller's organization. May be combined with `query` and `cpids`, or used on its own when neither is supplied.

parameters.name: cpids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of iTunes content provider identifiers used to scope the search to apps owned by those providers.

parameters.name: storeFronts
parameters.description: One or more storefront country or region codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) used to filter results. Repeat the parameter to supply multiple values. All values must be enabled storefronts; otherwise the request is rejected with `INVALID_COUNTRY_CODE`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset of the first page result to return.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return on a page. Capped at the service-side maximum (`MAXLIMIT`).

200.description: Searches for a list of apps

get.description: Searches the App Store for apps matching the supplied criteria.  **Behavior:** - At least one of `query`, `cpids`, or `returnOwnedApps=true` must be supplied.   Calls with none of these are rejected with `INVALID_INPUT`. - When `query` is supplied it must contain at least one alphanumeric   character; minimum length is 3 characters (2 for CJK languages). - `storeFronts` may be repeated to filter by multiple country or region codes.   All codes must be enabled storefronts. - Results are paginated; `limit` is capped at the service-side maximum   (`MAXLIMIT`) regardless of the requested value. - Response items include enrichment such as `appIcon`, `contentProviderId`,   `softwareRating`, `displayPolicies` and `eligibilities`.

get.summary: Searches for a list of geo locations

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Query geo search criteria. Minimum 2 characters. Use `*` to return all geos.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset of the first page result to return.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return on page.

parameters.name: countrycode
parameters.description: Country code based search criteria (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Defaults to US when omitted and entity is not Country.

parameters.name: supplySource
parameters.description: Supply source context for eligibility evaluation. **Required.** Case-insensitive (e.g., `maps`, `Maps`, `MAPS` are all equivalent). Hard-blocked geos for the specified supply source are always excluded. Soft-blocked geos pass through with eligibility data unless `eligible=true`.

parameters.name: eligible
parameters.description: Controls soft-block filtering. When `false` (default), only hard-blocked geos are excluded — soft-blocked geos (low search volume, sparse coverage) remain in results with eligibility data for the UI to handle. When `true`, both hard-blocked and soft-blocked geos are excluded.

200.description: Searches for a list of geo locations

get.description: Searches for a list of geo locations based on specified criteria.  **Behavior:** - `supplySource` is **required** — specifies the supply source context (APPSTORE or MAPS) - Hard-blocked geos (NO_MUID, NOT_SUPPORTED, SOURCE_REMOVED, COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED,   COUNTRY_NOT_SEARCHABLE) are always excluded from results - Soft-blocked geos (LOCALITY_LOW_SEARCH_VOLUME, POSTAL_CODE_SPARSE) pass through   with eligibility data by default — the UI decides how to present them - With `eligible=true`: soft-blocked geos are also excluded  **Supply source scoping:** - `supplySource=MAPS`: Countries excluded, results restricted to US/CA - `supplySource=APPSTORE`: PostalCode excluded  **Query constraints:** - Minimum query length: 2 characters (queries shorter than 2 chars are rejected with `MIN_QUERY_LENGTH`) - Wildcard `*` is accepted and returns all geos - If `countrycode` is omitted and `entity` is not `Country`, defaults to `US`

post.description: Query category suggestions. Supports two query routes based on `queryType`:          **Route 1: SUGGESTION** (discover categories for an app)          - `queryType` = `SUGGESTION` (REQUIRED)          - `promotedObjectId` (REQUIRED)          - `promotedObjectType` (REQUIRED)          Returns suggested categories based on the promoted object.          **Route 2: SEARCH** (look up or search categories)          - `queryType` = `SEARCH` (REQUIRED)          - `category` (REQUIRED) with operator:            - `IN`: fetches popularity for each provided category            - `LIKE`: performs a string match search across categories

Query keyword suggestions based on search terms and storefronts using structured filters.           **Required Filters:**          - `promotedObjectId` (campaign or app ID)          - `promotedObjectType` (type of promoted object)           **Optional Filters:**          - `terms` (search terms to get suggestions for)          - `countriesOrRegions` (storefront codes to target)

Query phrase suggestions. Supports two query routes based on `queryType`:          **Route 1: SUGGESTION** (discover phrases for an app)          - `queryType` = `SUGGESTION` (REQUIRED)          - `promotedObjectId` (REQUIRED)          - `promotedObjectType` (REQUIRED)          Returns suggested phrases based on the promoted object.          **Route 2: SEARCH** (look up or search phrases)          - `queryType` = `SEARCH` (REQUIRED)          - `phrase` (REQUIRED) with operator:            - `IN`: fetches popularity for each provided phrase            - `LIKE`: performs a string match search across phrases

Retrieve the suggested Target CPA bid for a new Max Conversions campaign on the App Store. The suggestion is the maximum tap-install CPI across the requested countries or regions that have at least 10 installs in the last 28 days.           **Required Filters:**          - `promotedObjectId` (single numeric app ID, `EQUALS`)          - `promotedObjectType` (`EQUALS` `APPSTORE_APP`)           **Optional Filters:**          - `countryOrRegion` (one or more ISO country/region codes). When omitted, all countries or regions with eligible install volume are considered.           Rate limited to 5 QPS per (user, organization).

ImpressionShareQueryResponse.description: Response wrapper for impression share query results.

day.description: Date of the data point (YYYY-MM-DD). Present when granularity is DAILY.

week.description: Week start date, Sunday (YYYY-MM-DD). Present when granularity is WEEKLY_SUN_SAT.

promotedObjectId.description: The Adam ID (App Store app identifier) of the promoted app. Serialized as a JSON string representation of an int64.

countryOrRegion.description: ISO country or region code (e.g., US, CA, GB).

searchTerm.description: The search term. Privacy-filtered: search terms with fewer than 10 impressions in the aggregation period are suppressed.

lowImpressionShare.description: Lower bound of the app's impression share (0-1). For 0%: 0. For 1%-90%: equals highImpressionShare (single-digit precision). For 91%-100%: 0.91.

highImpressionShare.description: Upper bound of the app's impression share (0-1). For 0%: 0. For 1%-90%: equals lowImpressionShare. For 91%-100%: 1.

rank.description: Stack-ranked position based on impression share against other apps for this search term + country combination. Rank 1 = highest impression share.

searchPopularity1to5.description: Index of search popularity for the search term (1-5). 5 = most popular.

ImpressionShareRow.description: A single impression share data row.

granularity.description: DAILY: daily aggregation, uses day date field. WEEKLY_SUN_SAT: fixed weekly aggregation (Sunday-Saturday), uses week date field.

ImpressionShareTimeRange.description: Time range for impression share queries. Timezone is fixed to UTC.

KeywordSuggestion.description: Keyword suggestion returned by the query endpoint with popularity score

LocaleInfo.description: Represents a specific language and its corresponding BCP47 code

id.description: Business Connect ID of the location

fullAddress.description: Concatenated full address string. Read-only, populated by Transformer.

adminAreaCode.description: Abbreviated administrative area code (e.g., "CA"). Future enhancement.

id.description: Business Connect ID of the location group

systemStatus.description: System-managed status. PENDING = awaiting BC evaluation (e.g., after rules change). VALID = BC confirmed membership. INVALID = BC evaluation failed.

query.description: RSQL query for DYNAMIC type (read-only, generated from rules)

rules.description: Structured rules for DYNAMIC groups. Converted to RSQL `query` on the server. Supported fields: adminArea, locality, postalCode, locationId. Operators: EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS (single value), IN, NOT_IN (multi-value with `value` array).

isAllLocationsGroup.description: True for the system-created "All Locations" group (read-only)

groupTotal.description: Total number of locations in the group (output only)

rules.description: Structured rules for DYNAMIC groups. Use instead of raw `query`. Supported fields: adminArea, locality, postalCode, locationId. Operators: EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, IN, NOT_IN. Use `value` for all operators (string for EQUALS/NOT_EQUALS, array for IN/NOT_IN).

LocationGroupType.description: How a LocationGroup is composed. DYNAMIC groups select members via rules; STATIC groups have a fixed, explicitly-enumerated member list.

rules.description: Structured rules for DYNAMIC groups. Changing rules sets systemStatus to PENDING. Use `value` for all operators (string for EQUALS/NOT_EQUALS, array for IN/NOT_IN).

orgId.description: The organization ID of the authenticated user.

userId.description: The user ID of the authenticated user.

amount.description: The monetary value in the specified currency. The API uses amount whenever a currency value is necessary. The string can contain up to two decimal digits.

currency.description: The organization’s default currency that is set up in the Apple Search Ads UI.

PhraseSuggestion.description: Phrase suggestion for discovering new advertising phrases

id.description: Product page identifier (ASC product page ID)

deepLink.description: Deep link URL for this product page

ProductPageDetails.description: Product page metadata (Default Product Page, Custom Product Page, or PPO)

productPageId.description: Parent product page identifier (ASC product page ID)

deviceClasses.description: Device families with available assets for this locale

assetsByDevice.description: Map of device type to DeviceAssetGroup

ProductPageLocaleDetails.description: Localized content for a product page

value.description: The filter value; type depends on the field being filtered

RateMetrics.description: Rate metrics breakdown by attribution type.

RecommendationCategory.description: Recommendation type category with system/merged variants. **Merged Categories** (combined view): - KEYWORD: Keyword recommendations - DAILYCAP: Daily budget recommendations - TCPA: Target CPA recommendations **System Categories** (algorithm-generated): - SKEYWORD, SDAILYCAP, STCPA

field.description: Field name to filter on (must match model field names)

value.description: Filter values (always array, even for single values)

RecommendationFilterCondition.description: Individual filter condition for querying recommendations.  **Operator Support by Field Type:** - String fields: EQUALS, IN, STARTS_WITH, CONTAINS, LIKE - Numeric fields: EQUALS, IN, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, BETWEEN - Date fields: EQUALS, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN - Enum fields: EQUALS, IN - List fields: CONTAINS_ANY, CONTAINS_ALL

sorting.description: Sort order for results (multiple fields supported)

filters.description: Filter conditions (promotedObjectId and promotedObjectType are REQUIRED)

RecommendationQueryRequest.description: Structured query request for filtering, sorting, and paginating recommendations.           **Required Filters:**          - `promotedObjectId` - Campaign or app identifier (REQUIRED)          - `promotedObjectType` - Type of promoted object (REQUIRED)           **Pagination:**          - Default offset: 0          - Default pageSize: 20           **Field Selection:**          - Specify `fields` array to reduce payload size          - Omit `fields` to receive all available fields

result.description: Response data (type varies by endpoint, null on error)

RecommendationResponseBody.description: Generic response wrapper for all API responses.  **Success Response:** - Contains `result` with requested data - Contains `pagination` for paginated queries - `error` is null  **Error Response:** - `result` is null - `pagination` is null - `error` contains error details

totalCount.description: Total number of items matching the query

ReportingAdChannelType.description: Channel type for a reporting campaign's ads.

ReportingAdGroupMin.description: Minimal ad group information included in nested objects.

ReportingBillingEvent.description: Billing event for a reporting campaign.

countryOrRegion.description: Country or region groupBy dimension value.

ReportingKeyword.description: Keyword metadata in a report row.

ReportingPricingModel.description: Pricing model for a reporting ad group.

countryOrRegion.description: Country or region groupBy dimension value.

ReportingSearchTerm.description: Search term metadata in a report row. Note: Only ORTZ timezone is supported for search term reports. UTC is not supported.

value.description: Single value string (for EQUALS/NOT_EQUALS) or array of string value (for IN/NOT_IN)

Rule.description: A single filter rule for DYNAMIC location groups. Use `value` (string) for EQUALS/NOT_EQUALS. Use `value` (array) for IN/NOT_IN.

legacyId.description: Pipe-delimited geo identifier encoding the hierarchy (geo_location.code). Examples: `US`, `US|CA`, `US|CA|San Francisco`, `US|TX|78238`

displayName.description: Localized display name with full hierarchy.

locality.description: Entity locality. Present for Locality entities only.

postalCode.description: Postal code value. Present for PostalCode entities only.

eligibility.description: Supply source eligibility restrictions for the requested supplySource only. Only shows blockedGroups matching the supplySource specified in the request. Null/omitted when the geo has no restrictions for the requested supply source.

SearchSupplySourceType.description: Supply source context for geo search.

sorting.description: Sort criteria. Maximum 2 sort fields. Default genre ASC, rankInGenre ASC.

SearchTermPopularityQueryRequest.description: Request body for the search term popularity query endpoint. Timezone is fixed to UTC.

SearchTermPopularityQueryResponse.description: Response wrapper for search term popularity query results.

week.description: The start date of the completed weekly range (YYYY-MM-DD). Present when granularity is WEEKLY.

month.description: Calendar month of the report snapshot (YYYY-MM). Present when granularity is MONTHLY.

searchTerm.description: The search term. Must meet eligibility criteria: >= 500 searches and >= 10 impressions within the reporting period.

rankInGenre.description: Rank of the search term by search volume within its Country/Region and Genre. Rank 1 = highest volume. Up to 500 search terms per Country/Genre combination.

searchPopularityInGenre.description: Popularity within Country/Region and Genre (1-100). 100 = most popular within that genre.

searchPopularity1to100.description: Popularity across all genres within Country/Region (1-100). 100 = most popular. Enables comparison with searchPopularityInGenre.

searchPopularity1to5.description: Popularity across all genres within Country/Region (1-5). 5 = most popular. Matches the Search Popularity metric used in Campaign Management.

SearchTermPopularityRow.description: A single search term popularity data row.

start.description: Start date. For WEEKLY_SUN_SAT: YYYY-MM-DD format. For MONTHLY: YYYY-MM-DD format.

end.description: End date. For WEEKLY_SUN_SAT: YYYY-MM-DD format. For MONTHLY: YYYY-MM-DD format.

granularity.description: WEEKLY_SUN_SAT: fixed weekly reports (Sunday-Saturday). Generated Mondays at 07:00 UTC. Rolling 65-week retention. MONTHLY: calendar month snapshots. Refreshes on the 5th of each month UTC. Rolling 15-month retention.

SearchTermPopularityTimeRange.description: Time range for search term popularity queries. Timezone is fixed to UTC.

TargetCpaRecommendation.description: Target cost-per-acquisition recommendation for optimizing campaign CPA goals.  Based on historical performance and market conditions.

TargetCpaRecommendationHistory.description: Historical record of an applied or dismissed target CPA recommendation

countryOrRegion.description: Country or region for this suggestion

TargetCpaSuggestion.description: Suggested target CPA for a campaign based on historical performance and market conditions

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. For HOURLY granularity: must be within the last 7 days. For DAILY granularity: must be within the last 90 days. For WEEKLY granularity: must be within the last 365 days.

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. For WEEKLY granularity: must be at least 14 days in the past. For MONTHLY granularity: must be at least 90 days in the past.

timeZone.description: Timezone for the report date range. ORTZ uses the ad account's local timezone. Note: UTC is not supported for the SEARCHTERM entity (both APPS and BRANDS).

granularity.description: Time granularity for the report rows. HOURLY: Not supported for SEARCHTERM or AD entities. Date range must start within the last 7 days. DAILY: Date range start must be within the last 90 days. WEEKLY: Date range start within the last 365 days; end date at least 14 days in the past. MONTHLY: End date must be at least 90 days in the past.

UploadAssetPromotedObjectTypeEnum.description: Type of promoted object. Only BUSINESS_BRAND is supported by this endpoint. Declared in src/api/apple-ads-api.ts (not src/model).

acls.description: List of ACL entries, one per ad account.

roles.description: List of role names the user has on this ad account.

UserAcl.description: An Access Control List entry for a single ad account.
